Attached OLD atlas is an appearance cue only. Redraw every pose; correct equipment and role according to the text above. Never copy old offensive effects into a support action.

ROW 2: OUTRO (1) lower wand, (2) switch off emitter with thumb and look down, (3) secure wand on sling, (4) turn away with a dry small open-palm farewell.
ROW 3: ROUND VICTORY (1) exhale shoulders dropping, (2) check the wand held low, (3) brief restrained one-hand shrug with other hand on wand, (4) regain alert stance.

ROW 7: MATCH DEFEAT alive fatigue: (1) shoulders sag with equipment safely down, (2) sink to one knee with free palm on thigh if available, (3) rest on heel head lowered with all held objects still physically supported, (4) lift head and brace to rise, both complete feet visible. ROW 8: SUPER (1) connected wand DOWN/off at waist, (2) feet wide and emitter raised two-handed RIGHT, (3) front knee bends and torso leans into a sustained lock with small local emitter spark, (4) power off and lower whole wand while straightening.
